title: The canon as serial dictation
statement: Read as a textual corpus, the canon is a serial dictation: received in discrete reported sessions (six mornings in 1973, one October night in 1975) and released across six years in three books by a reporter who retained editorial control of his own revelation throughout — a compositional profile that discourse analysis can characterize (a consistent principal speaker, staged disclosure, retrospective framing of earlier books by later ones) independently of the encounters' historicity.

includes: The compositional profile as textual observation: session structure, publication seriality (1974, 1975, 1979), the consistent principal speaker, and the later books' retrospective framing of earlier ones
The editorial-control observation: the reporter as sole transmitter and editor of the messages, a fact the texts themselves display

The analytical consequence: the corpus can be studied with the tools applied to other serially delivered scriptures (dictation traditions, routinization analysis), and the project's own source discipline benefits from that study
The independence clause: every observation here survives both the contact account and the composition account of woh-claim-0020's alternative
excludes: Historicity of the encounters (woh-claim-0001's burden) and the reports' documentation (woh-claim-0020's)
Authenticity adjudication; the profile is compatible with reception and with authorship, and the record does not choose
Extension of the analysis to the movement's later, post-canonical texts

source_references.locator: The six-morning session frame and the first book's compositional structure
The 1975 session and the second book's retrospective framing of the first
The third book's consolidation and the six-year arc's close
Weber's routinization frame, applied to the corpus's charismatic-to-textual transition

alternatives.statement: The compositional profile fits any single-author serial publication; it characterizes without discriminating, and adds nothing to the provenance record.
Staged disclosure and retrospective framing are standard in revelation genres; the profile is the genre's, not this corpus's.
